diagnosis: The check C7 passed in all four rollouts because the settlement decisions matched the default behavior of allocating all released modules and ensuring traceability for Model Y, as specified by PF4. This is evident from the consistent allocation of 240 held modules to Model Y and the verification of traceability, which aligns with the destination requirement stated in PF4.

C7.why: The destination requirement changes Model Y dispatch from ordinary shipment release to verified serialized traceability and a lot-specific compliance certificate.
